description: This file is a shell script automating build, patching, testing, and coverage reporting workflows for an embedded software project. It manages cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring builds with CMake, executing tests (including special handling for code coverage), staging plugins, and preparing artifacts for review or CI pipelines. The script is specific to the entservices-appgateway-34 project and orchestrates various dependencies like Thunder, ThunderTools, GoogleTest, and the entservices-apis modules.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git reference (tag, branch, or remote head) in a repository directory, cloning if necessary.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if not already present, or updates it and checks out the specified reference.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository directory, honoring idempotency markers.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a CMake-based project component with standard flags and optional extra arguments.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
methods.description: Configures and builds a CMake project component without proceeding to install, used to avoid side effects during testing.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the current environment.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables to run git commands non-interactively.
